title: Nebula carousel GWT example public behavior subset
method: Source-blind, same-origin iframe; visible DOM, public control events and Canvas 2D pixel readback only

fixtures.scope: Fixture URLs, image dimensions and white view configuration are supplied setup assumptions; this harness does not inspect application source or fixture source.

clauses.expect: Within 5000 ms the rendered example has exactly one visible canvas[role=img], a 320 by 180 backing buffer, visible enabled Previous and Next controls, visible Selected image 1 text, and an opaque #cc3322 center pixel.
Each action synchronously changes the visible contained Selected image N text to its expected selection; appended instructions are allowed; conflicting selection status is rejected.
At the end of each 650 ms selection settling window, the actual Canvas center pixel is opaque and exactly matches the selected fixture color, and visible selection text is still correct.
Buttons are exercised with HTMLElement.click(); arrow navigation focuses the Canvas and dispatches a bubbling KeyboardEvent to it, without application objects or internals.

The outer exact <pre id="results"> marker contains JSON with exactly status, assertions and message. Assertions is an integer count. PASS requires all independent actions and the composed owner report; error or timeout publishes FAIL.

antiCheat: Read actual Canvas pixels at initial readiness and after every action
Check immediate status and status after settling
Exercise both wrap directions and both arrow keys
outOfScope: White-background buffer alpha or CSS compositing
Native SWT, RWT/RAP, JNI and resource lifecycle
Cross-origin images, empty or invalid data, persistence and refresh

composition.revisionReason: Root requested one owned browser profile and a composed visible owner-harness report after the original contract and harness authoring; this section is frozen before composition code changes.
composition.access: Read only the owner iframe's visible pre#results JSON, never its JS, source or implementation objects.
composition.passGate: Independent public example actions pass and owner report is PASS with assertions greater than zero.
composition.failureGate: Owner FAIL, malformed final owner report, runtime error or the 9000 ms overall deadline causes outer FAIL.
composition.outerAssertions: Independent passed assertion count plus the owner report's assertion count.
composition.outerMessage: Always distinguish independentAssertions=N and ownerReportAssertions=M; owner checks are reported by their harness and are not claimed as independently validated.
composition.presentation: Two visible iframes side by side, approximately 480 by 600 each, in a 1024 by 768 viewport; separate visible pre#independent-evidence retains independent records.
composition.qualificationScope: Owner-report observation is a composition gate; independent behavioral qualification remains limited to the public example subset.

authoringStatus: Re-frozen input contract before composition code changes; no browser or application execution performed by the validator author
